tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Searches active NYC rental listings from StreetEasy, LeaseBreak, NYBits, Reddit, and building websites, plus lease takeovers posted on Buzzedin. Supports price, bedrooms, neighborhoods, boroughs, move-in dates, commute time to an address, distance to places (subway, grocery, a named store), amenitie

tools.name: create_alert_link
tools.description: Create a link that opens this search on Buzzedin, where the user can save it as an alert and get an email or push notification when a new matching listing appears. Pass the same filters used for search_listings. Use it when the user wants to be notified, or accepts the offer of an alert.

tools.name: save_alert
tools.description: Save a search as an alert on the user's own Buzzedin account, so they get an email when a new matching listing appears. Pass the same filters used for search_listings. Needs the user to connect their free Buzzedin account; free accounts can keep one alert.

tools.name: list_my_alerts
tools.description: List the alerts saved on the user's Buzzedin account, with whether each is active. Needs the user to connect their Buzzedin account.

tools.name: get_my_matches
tools.description: Show the newest listings that matched the user's Buzzedin alerts, up to 8, with the same details as search_listings. On the free plan, the newest matches stay hidden until their alert email goes out. Needs the user to connect their Buzzedin account.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_alert_link, save_alert, get_my_matches · Public sink: create_alert_link, save_alert, get_my_matches.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_alert_link, save_alert, get_my_matches · Public sink: create_alert_link, save_alert, get_my_matches

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
